name: ai-work-os
description: AI Work OS: an operating layer of rules, boards, receipts and skill packs for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: aiwos-core
plugins.description: Evidence loop, job packets, handoffs, EOD logging, onboarding and what-now. Start here.

plugins.name: aiwos-business
plugins.description: Six day-one jobs for a Malaysian SME owner: sort leads, draft WhatsApp replies, build quotes, and check anything before it goes into AI or out to a customer. Drafts only.

plugins.name: aiwos-thinking
plugins.description: Seven thinking tools for scoping work, writing copy that lands, and running a goal loop with review built in.

plugins.name: aiwos-marketing
plugins.description: Three drafting jobs from real work: Google Business Profile posts, follow-up messages with stop rules, and turning a sanitised job into shareable content. Drafts only.

plugins.name: aiwos-web
plugins.description: site-loop: brief, build, local preview, phone+desktop light+dark captures, a console-error check and a preview deploy — stopping before production for you to approve.

plugins.name: aiwos-video
plugins.description: video-brief turns a real job into a 30-60s script, shot list and caption rules for a video builder, plus a deterministic SRT/VTT caption lint.

plugins.name: aiwos-sales
plugins.description: Four sales jobs: qualify public prospects, plan discovery calls, build scope-led proposals from supplied rate rules, and keep a follow-up queue. Drafts only.

plugins.name: aiwos-delivery
plugins.description: Three delivery jobs: prepare a kickoff, produce the agreed deliverable with an unresolved list, and run an independent quality gate. Nothing is released without a person's decision.

plugins.name: aiwos-plan
plugins.description: Two small planning jobs: review the weekly bottleneck and stress-test an important decision.

plugins.name: aiwos-handoff
plugins.description: Six jobs for moving bounded work between AI tools with work orders, receipts, leases and independent checks.
